# 🔒 MASKED ecash drop #1

10 winners × 1,000 sats of Cashu ecash. Each token is **locked to the winner's own bc1p address**: only that address can claim it, so a copied token is worthless to anyone else.

Unclaimed tokens return to MASKED on **11 Nov 2026, 17:34 UK time**.

## How to claim

1. Open **MASKED** with the wallet that holds your address. ([Get MASKED on the Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/pojmpfcbdmacabhckemelcbkmckhaoig))
2. Find your @name below and click the **copy** icon on your token.
3. In MASKED: **Ecash → paste → Claim**. Done ✅

> Gave a UniSat address? Restore the same recovery phrase in MASKED and you'll get the same address.
> **Never share your recovery phrase with anyone. MASKED will never ask for it.**

Watch how it works: [MASKED ecash](./ECASH.md)
